title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Oil up, semis ripping, everything else flat. Crude’s +2.91% spike on Iran/Hormuz headlines plus Howard Lutnick’s anti-China memory comments drove a narrow AI-hardware bid; the S&P’s -0.47% masks a tape where only energy and chip names mattered.

INDICES — VIX 15.2, down vs 16.5 20-day MA. Ranked: QQQ -0.16%, IJH -0.24%, IWM -0.34%, IJR -0.41%, SPY -0.47%, DIA -0.49%. Small > large by 0.18pp. SOXX +1.58% versus SPY -0.47% — biggest cross-asset divergence.

VOLUME — SPY vol_ratio 0.83x, QQQ 0.83x, both average. IJH at 1.6x gaining attention, SOXX 0.6x ignored — chips rallying on thin volume. Price down on average volume = distribution for SPY.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLE +1.08%, XLK +0.16%, XLI -0.10%, XLV -0.19%, XLU -0.29%, XLB -0.57%, XLRE -0.97%, XLF -1.00%, XLY -1.23%, XLP -1.64%, XLC -1.89%. Top: DRAM +5.36%, WGMI +3.06%; bottom: TAN -2.02%, JETS -2.25%. Money into energy and memory semis, out of consumer discretionary, staples, comms. Rotation label: 'AI hardware leading'.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 0.80 low complacency; QQQ PCR 1.92 extreme protection demand. QQQ skew +8.8% steep put premium. SPY GEX flip 778 vs spot well below — dealer hedging amplifies downside. VIX 15.2 below 20-day MA, but MOVE 75.6 above its 69.9 MA — bond vol stress rising.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil +2.91% pressuring 20Y+ Treasuries -0.84% while gold +1.00% and silver +1.86% rally — dollar -0.04% flat. Oil-led inflation fear hitting long bonds but not hurting metals, unusual.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 52.2 Neutral. Top movers: TER +5.81%, AMAT +5.55% (earnings beat), MRVL +5.54% (Benzinga). V at 2.3x vol, -1.46% — distribution. 20d momentum: XLK +8.31% best, XLC +0.02% worst; SLV +16.85% basket leader. Watch AMAT (vol spike post-earnings, +5.55%), SOXX (thin-volume rally at 0.6x, 20d +6.67%), QQQ (PCR 1.92 gamma flip 733 proximity).
